rule: held-out split by match DATE (local date in the log file name live_play_YYYYMMDD_*), fixed before any fit
opp_leak_rule: pre-registered: the opponent's leak (from the logged public counter opp_elixir_est) enters the fit only if its per-match total correlates with the battle log's public opponent elixirLeaked at Pearson r >= 0.7 on the matched matches; otherwise the leak feature is our own leak only (documented)
checkpoint_rule: a match counts at checkpoint t only if its last frame is after t (ended matches are not scored at later checkpoints); the model used is the phase of t (60 s -> 1x, 120 s -> 2x, 180 s -> OT); 'end' = last frame, model of its phase
